exercises.question: Which sentence combines a past habit with a present change?
options: Aunque antes discutíamos mucho, últimamente nos hemos acercado. [Although we used to argue a lot, lately we have become closer.]
Aunque antes discutíamos mucho, en el futuro nos acercaremos. [Although we used to argue a lot, in the future we will get closer.]
Aunque antes discutimos mucho, últimamente nos hemos acercado. [Although we argued a lot before, lately we have become closer.]

exercises.sentence: Después del __, se reconciliaron y volvieron a hablar.
exercises.english: After the misunderstanding, they made up and started talking again.
Although we used to argue a lot, lately we have become closer.

sentences: Antes discutíamos con frecuencia. [We used to argue frequently.]
Después dejamos de hablar durante unos días. [Then we stopped speaking for a few days.]
Finalmente nos reconciliamos. [Finally we made up.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: Fue una buena idea hablar así.

options: Nos escuchamos con atención y nos reconciliamos. [We listened to each other carefully and made up.]
Nos escucharemos con atención y nos reconciliaremos pronto. [We will listen to each other carefully and make up soon.]
Nos escuchábamos con atención y nos reconciliábamos. [We used to listen to each other carefully and make up.]

exercises.question: What is a «desacuerdo»? [¿Qué es un «desacuerdo»?]
options: a disagreement [una diferencia de opinión]
a long meeting [una reunión larga]
a good habit [un buen hábito]

exercises.sentence: La persona con __ tuve el desacuerdo ha cambiado.
exercises.english: The person I had the disagreement with has changed.

exercises.question: How many sisters lived in the March house? [¿Cuántas hermanas vivían en casa de las March?]
options: Four. [Cuatro.]
Two. [Dos.]
Three. [Tres.]

exercises.question: What did the sisters usually do when they were little? [¿Qué solían hacer las hermanas de pequeñas?]
options: They got together with their mother in the afternoon. [Se reunían con su madre por las tardes.]
They went to work together every day in town. [Iban juntas al trabajo todos los días en la ciudad.]
They stayed in different houses in different towns. [Se quedaban en casas diferentes en otros pueblos.]

exercises.question: What did the mother advise Jo and Meg to do? [¿Qué les aconsejó la madre a Jo y a Meg?]
options: To talk calmly. [Hablar con calma.]
To stop seeing each other. [Dejar de verse.]
To ask their sister Amy. [Preguntarle a su hermana Amy.]

exercises.question: How did the disagreement end? [¿Cómo terminó el desacuerdo?]
options: They listened to each other and made up. [Se escucharon y se reconciliaron.]
They continued arguing. [Siguieron discutiendo.]
They stopped trusting each other. [Dejaron de confiar la una en la otra.]

exercises.sentence: Aunque antes discutíamos mucho, últimamente nos hemos acercado.
options: Although we used to argue a lot, lately we have become closer.
Although we used to argue a lot, lately we have become more distant.
Although we argue a lot now, we used to be closer.

exercises.sentence: Después del malentendido, nos reconciliamos y nos entendimos mejor.
exercises.english: After the misunderstanding, we made up and understood each other better.

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: Describe la relación entre vosotros ahora.

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: Entonces habéis aprendido de los problemas.

options: Hemos cambiado y ahora nos entendemos mejor, aunque todavía no estamos de acuerdo en todo. [We have changed and now understand each other better, although we still do not agree on everything.]
Cambiábamos y ahora nos entendemos mejor, aunque todavía no estamos de acuerdo en todo. [We used to change and now understand each other better, although we still do not agree on everything.]
Hemos cambiado y ahora nos entendimos mejor, aunque todavía no estamos de acuerdo en todo. [We have changed and now we understood each other better, although we still do not agree on everything.]

exercises.question: Which structure best identifies the person involved in a disagreement?
options: la persona con quien tuve el desacuerdo [the person I had the disagreement with]
la persona donde tuve el desacuerdo [the person where I had the disagreement]
la persona cuando tuve el desacuerdo [the person when I had the disagreement]

exercises.sentence: Después del problema, hemos aprendido a __ el uno al otro.
exercises.english: After the problem, we have learned to listen to each other.

template.prompt: Describe a difficult relationship using a past habit and a recent change.
template.answer: Antes discutíamos mucho, pero últimamente nos hemos acercado.

template.prompt: Describe how two people resolved a conflict.
template.answer: Se escucharon con atención y se reconciliaron después del malentendido.

template.prompt: Identify a person using a relative clause and describe the relationship.
template.answer: La persona con quien tuve el desacuerdo ha cambiado, y ahora confiamos más el uno en el otro.

template.prompt: Give a general lesson about relationships.
template.answer: Las personas que saben escucharse pueden resolver un desacuerdo con más facilidad.
